semiconductor_relevance: High — FUJIFILM Electronic Materials (Europe) is a leading supplier of high-performance chemicals and materials specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: FUJIFILM Electronic Materials (Europe) provides a comprehensive range of high-purity chemicals and advanced photopolymers tailored for semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include state-of-the-art photoresists, specialty coatings, and ultra-pure CVD chemicals, catering to the needs of technologically demanding semiconductor manufacturers.
capabilities: High-performance photoresists for EUV and 193nm technology
Specialty polyimides for protective layers in packaging
CMP slurries optimized for various technology nodes

regional_presence.Europe: FUJIFILM Electronic Materials (Europe) operates as a key supplier within the European semiconductor market.
